posts.text:
🥩 THE MEAT GRINDER IS OPEN {OPEN} 🥩

Got pets you were going to discard anyway? Don't toss them. GRIND THEM. 🐸🔪

🎰 69 XCPETS per grind. Drop your discarded pets in the hopper and crank.
🍖 Meat per pet: Common 1, Uncommon 2, Rare 5, Legendary 20.
🎡 Every 250 meat = a free Pepe Wheel spin.
🌭 Every 1,000 meat = a Sausage Egg that never hatches Common.
✨ Every grind has a small shot at a GOLDEN SAUSAGE: a sure Legendary.

🚫 Gods, Mythics, Wizards and tokenized pets are too powerful for the hopper.

Find it in My Pets > More > Care. Feed the machine. xcpets.fun
